evidence.quote: Take appropriate measures throughout the development of advanced AI systems, including prior to and throughout their deployment and placement on the market, to identify, evaluate, and mitigate risks across the AI lifecycle.
establishing a safety framework of AI validation prior to their release to the market
employing diverse internal and independent external testing measures, through a combination of methods such as red-teaming
employing diverse internal and independent external testing measures, through a combination of methods such as red-teaming
The US announced that it would establish the US AI Safety Institute in the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) to implement an AI risk management framework and evaluate red teaming.
Work towards responsible information sharing and reporting of incidents among organizations developing advanced AI systems including with industry, governments, civil society, and academia.
encouraged to maintain appropriate documentation of reported incidents and to mitigate the identified risks and vulnerabilities
Publicly report advanced AI systems' capabilities, limitations and domains of appropriate and inappropriate use, to support ensuring sufficient transparency
provide and explain information summarizing the items listed below according to the knowledge and ability of each stakeholder
record or store logs of AI training processes, inference processes, rationales of decisions made by AI
Documentation of system architectures and the like
Make a reasonable explanation of what decision was made, starting with the source of the data, and document and publish it to ensure traceability.
employing diverse internal and independent external testing measures
Consider operational measures for information security and appropriate cyber/physical access control, etc.
Develop and deploy reliable content authentication and provenance mechanisms, where technically feasible, such as watermarking or other techniques to enable users to identify AI-generated content.
Intervention by decisions made by humans
implement reliable, human-centric AI
it is important that each AI business actor provides stakeholders with information to the reasonable extent necessary
It is encouraged to introduce other mechanisms, such as labelling and disclaimer labelling
It is expected to establish and disclose AI governance policies and practices.
Work towards responsible information sharing and reporting of incidents among organizations developing advanced AI systems
These include reports on monitoring results and documents related to security and safety risks.
